highlights.label: 单循环随机极小极大方法追平多循环复杂度
highlights.text: SPDE 把投影预测—校正、阻尼对偶动量和法锥修正合入单循环；递推方差缩减版 VR-SPDE 在非凸—强凹情形取得 $O(\kappa^{3/2}\varepsilon^{-3})$，一般凹情形的优化平稳复杂度为 $O(\varepsilon^{-6})$，达到已知多循环方法的最佳阶。

highlights.label: 非凸弹性与占据测度松弛实现无间隙
highlights.text: 对关于 Cauchy–Green 应变张量凸的框架无关能量，原非凸变分问题与占据测度线性矩松弛具有相同下确界；线性边界条件和 SOS-凸应变能下，Lasserre 层级第一层即精确。

highlights.label: 遗憾最小化｜系统生成固定点迭代
highlights.text: 非扩张映射固定点被转成余 cocoercive 算子零点，在线遗憾界随之变成残差界；AdaGrad-Norm、对角和全矩阵版本分别导出自适应缩放与预条件固定点算法。

highlights.label: 谱分解系统统一非凸谱优化的一阶变分公式
highlights.text: 作者先在特征值、奇异值等不变量空间构造法锥和次微分，再统一提升回矩阵或算子空间，覆盖 Hermitian 分解、矩形奇异值和 Euclidean Jordan 代数等结构；同时给出可微性刻画与广义 Lidskiĭ 扰动定理。

highlights.label: 移动平均｜精确刻画线性迭代稳定域
highlights.text: 固定窗口平均的矩阵迭代稳定域得到显式、凸、半代数刻画；窗口增长会严格扩张稳定区域，但无限窗口极限仍只覆盖连续时间稳定半平面的真子集。

papers.title: Single-Loop Stochastic Projected Damped Extragradient Methods for Stochastic Nonconvex--(Strongly) Concave Minimax Optimization
papers.abstract: We develop single-loop stochastic projected damped extragradient methods for stochastic nonconvex--(strongly) concave minimax optimization, with complexity guarantees for both game stationarity (GS) and optimization stationarity (OS). Our approach combines a stochastic projected damped extragradient (SPDE) method with a recursive variance-reduced variant, VR-SPDE, both of which retain a single-loop structure. Under an unbiased stochastic gradient oracle with uniformly bounded variance, SPDE finds an $\varepsilon$-game-stationary point with stochastic first-order oracle (SFO) complexities of $O(κ\varepsilon^{-4})$ and $O(\varepsilon^{-5})$ in the nonconvex--strongly concave and nonconvex--concave settings, respectively, where $κ=L/μ$. Under an additional mean-square Lipschitz condition on the stochastic gradients, VR-SPDE improves these GS complexities to $O(κ^{3/2}\varepsilon^{-3})$ and $O(\varepsilon^{-9/2})$, respectively. For an $\varepsilon$-optimization-stationary point, SPDE achieves SFO complexities of $O(κ\varepsilon^{-4})$ and $O(\varepsilon^{-6})$, while VR-SPDE achieves $O(κ^{3/2}\varepsilon^{-3})$ and $O(\varepsilon^{-6})$, in the two settings, respectively. These OS guarantees match the best-known bounds achieved by multi-loop methods while preserving a single-loop implementation. To the best of our knowledge, our results provide the best-known SFO complexity guarantees among single-loop stochastic first-order methods for the respective stationarity criteria and problem classes.
papers.summary: 论文研究带凸约束的随机非凸—（强）凹极小极大问题，同时区分博弈平稳性与原始值函数的优化平稳性。作者把投影预测—校正、阻尼对偶动量、法锥修正和松弛近端中心统一到单循环 SPDE 中，并以沿同一查询序列递推的估计器构造 VR-SPDE，避免为正则化子问题设置内层迭代。在无偏且方差一致有界的随机一阶 oracle 下，SPDE 在强凹与一般凹情形达到相应的 $O(κ\varepsilon^{-4})$ 和 $O(\varepsilon^{-5})$ 博弈平稳复杂度；加入均方 Lipschitz 条件后，VR-SPDE 改善为 $O(κ^{3/2}\varepsilon^{-3})$ 与 $O(\varepsilon^{-9/2})$。对优化平稳性，强凹情形同样获得 $O(κ^{3/2}\varepsilon^{-3})$，一般凹情形为 $O(\varepsilon^{-6})$，后者通过原始值函数的 Moreau 包络刻画。
papers.reason: 最值得关注的是作者在不引入内层求解器的前提下，把单循环实现推进到可与最佳多循环方法比较的精度依赖，并明确分开两种平稳性指标所需的正则化尺度与 oracle 条件。对随机极小极大算法研究而言，这套“阻尼外梯度 + 近端中心 + 同序列递归方差缩减”的组合既便于实现，也提供了分析不同平稳性偏差来源的清楚范式。

papers.title: Beyond Shadow Weights: Quantization-Aware Training as Quantized-Endpoint Descent
papers.abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) updates a full-precision shadow weight $\mathbf{x}$ but deploys the quantized endpoint $Q(\mathbf{x})$. Existing explanations for QAT largely view its success through the lens of shadow weights: QAT can move $\mathbf{x}$ toward flatter basins, gain robustness from quantization-induced oscillations, or balance the shadow loss $f(\mathbf{x})$ against the quantization error $\|\mathbf{x}-Q(\mathbf{x})\|_2$. These perspectives do not directly explain the empirical observation that the deployed endpoint loss $f(Q(\mathbf{x}))$ improves while the shadow loss $f(\mathbf{x})$ does not, and can even increase substantially. In this paper, we offer a different explanation by treating QAT as finite-grid endpoint dynamics. Motivated by the approximate normality of rescaled pretrained weights, we propose an idealized model for the residual phase, which records where each shadow weight sits inside its quantization cell as a fraction of the cell width. This model leads to a crossing law that determines which coordinates cross quantization boundaries after a shadow update. Inspired by the idealized model and signal-imbalance phenomenon in QAT, we further propose QAR (Quantization with Amplified Routing), an algorithmic framework that directly operates on the quantization code. In contrast to QAT, QAR is both theoretically grounded and memory-efficient: it admits feasible-gradient bounds for a family of power amplifiers up to unavoidable finite-grid floors without retaining a full-precision shadow weight copy. Experiments on post-training of large language models provide evidence consistent with the endpoint view and show that QAR can be comparable to or better than QAT with smaller memory cost.
papers.summary: 量化感知训练实际部署的是离散端点 $Q(\mathbf{x})$，但传统解释多围绕全精度影子权重展开，无法说明端点损失下降而影子损失反而上升的现象。该文用量化单元内的残差相位建立理想化模型，把影子更新转化为坐标跨越量化边界的随机律，并据此直接分析有限网格上的端点运动。作者进一步提出 QAR，通过放大强信号对应的转移概率直接更新量化码，不再保存全精度影子权重；在坐标光滑和步长不截断转移概率等条件下，证明可行梯度的时间平均以 $O(T^{-1})$ 下降到不可避免的网格误差地板。低比特大模型后训练实验显示，QAR 可达到与 QAT 相当或更好的效果，并把峰值训练显存最多降低 26.3%。
papers.reason: 这项工作的核心价值不只是提出一个低内存算法，而是把评价对象从连续影子变量改回真正部署的离散端点，从而给出解释边界跨越、信号不平衡与量化振荡的统一机制。有限网格下的可行梯度证书和紧误差地板也为离散约束优化提供了可复用的分析语言；同时应注意现有理论针对权重量化，尚未覆盖输入相关的激活量化。

papers.title: Semidefinite relaxations for nonlinear elasticity with energies convex in the Cauchy-Green strain tensor
papers.abstract: In nonlinear elasticity, finding the deformation of a material which minimizes a given stored energy density is a challenging calculus of variations problem which may fail to have minimizers: the energy optimal material forms infinitely fine microstructures (wrinkles) rather than deforming smoothly. In the case where the energy function is non-convex but frame indifferent and convex with respect to the Cauchy-Green strain tensor, we use the standard Le Dret-Raoult semidefinite projection formula for the quasiconvex envelope of the energy function together with a recent no gap result for convex calculus of variation problems to prove that there is no relaxation gap between the original non-convex calculus of variations problem and its linear moment formulation based on occupation measures. This implies convergence of the Lasserre moment-sum-of-squares (SOS) hierarchy and provides a computationally efficient, mesh-free numerical method that, unlike the finite element method, avoids undesirable mesh-dependent artifacts. Under the additional condition that the boundary condition is linear and the function is SOS convex in the strain tensor, we show that the first relaxation of the Lasserre hierarchy is exact. In other words, computing the quasiconvex envelope at a point boils down to solving a small convex semidefinite optimization problem.
papers.summary: 非线性弹性能量通常关于变形梯度非凸，最优序列可能形成无限细微结构，因而原问题甚至不取得极小值。该文针对具有框架无关性、且关于 Cauchy–Green 应变张量凸的能量，结合 Le Dret–Raoult 的半正定投影公式与新的凸变分无间隙结果，证明原非凸变分问题与基于占据测度的线性矩松弛具有相同下确界。由此得到 Lasserre 矩—SOS 层级的收敛保证和无网格数值途径；若边界条件线性且应变能关于应变张量 SOS-凸，第一层松弛即精确，点态拟凸包计算可归结为一个低维凸半正定规划。
papers.reason: 推荐重点是一个很强的结构性精确化结果：对看似无限维且非凸、还可能不取到解的变分问题，作者找到了从对称性与应变凸性到无松弛间隙、再到第一层 SDP 精确性的完整链条。它展示了识别正确不变量后，矩松弛不仅给出渐近层级，还可能直接成为小规模精确算法；边界在于结论依赖框架无关性及应变张量凸性，尚未覆盖更一般的多凸或仅拟凸能量。

papers.title: Benign Nonconvex Landscape for Policy Optimization: Infinite-Horizon Discounted MDPs with General State and Action Spaces
papers.abstract: We study the optimization landscape for infinite-horizon discounted Markov decision processes (MDPs) with general state and action spaces under structured stationary policy classes. A general weighted policy-iteration approach to establishing global convergence guarantees for policy gradient methods requires closure under weighted policy improvement at every policy, a property that may fail even when the policy class contains an optimal policy. To address this issue, we propose weaker conditions that guarantee the absence of suboptimal stationary points and establish the Polyak--Lojasiewicz--Kurdyka (PLK) condition for the policy gradient objective with a finite concentrability coefficient. We also establish the PLK condition from a policy-improvement bound that holds at every state, without a concentrability assumption. Our general results encompass settings covered by the earlier framework when the common standing assumptions hold for the same policy class and parameter domain. We further verify our proposed conditions for two operations models: inventory systems with Markov-modulated demand and stochastic cash-balance problems. For both models, the Bellman equation yields approximate convexity of the Q-value functions in the action variable, with deviations controlled by the first-order stationarity measure. These estimates establish exponent-one and, under additional curvature assumptions, exponent-two PLK conditions, which, together with Lipschitz continuity of the policy gradient, imply an $\mathcal{O}(1/ε)$ iteration complexity and linear convergence, respectively, for projected gradient descent using exact policy gradients. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first non-asymptotic convergence rates for solving infinite-horizon discounted inventory systems with Markov-modulated demand and stochastic cash-balance problems using policy gradient methods.
papers.summary: 论文研究一般状态、动作空间上的无限时域折扣 MDP，并指出既有加权策略迭代分析要求策略类对每个当前策略的改进步骤都闭合，即使策略类包含最优策略，该要求也可能失败。作者把条件弱化为只在平稳点处排除闭合误差，或用一阶平稳性度量控制类内改进差与闭合误差，从而在有限集中系数下建立策略梯度目标的 PŁK 条件；另一条逐状态改进界则不需要集中性假设。对 Markov 调制需求库存与随机现金余额模型，Bellman 方程给出动作方向的近似凸性，进而在基线条件下得到 $O(1/ε)$ 迭代复杂度，在额外曲率与需求密度下得到线性收敛。
papers.reason: 这篇论文把常被直接假设的“良性非凸景观”真正从 MDP 结构中推导出来，并明确给出两条互补路线：有限集中系数下的平均改进分析，以及无需集中性假设的逐状态分析。尤其值得读的是它展示了精确闭合并非必要条件，并为两个连续状态运筹模型给出首批非渐近策略梯度保证；这些保证目前针对精确策略梯度，随机估计误差仍需另行处理。

papers.title: A regret minimization approach to fixed-point iterations
papers.abstract: We propose a conversion scheme that turns regret minimizing algorithms into fixed point iterations, with convergence guarantees following from regret bounds. The resulting iterations can be seen as a grand extension of the classical Krasnoselskii--Mann iterations, as the latter are recovered by converting the Online Gradient Descent algorithm. This approach yields new simple iterations for finding fixed points of non-self operators. We also focus on converting algorithms from the AdaGrad family of regret minimizers, and thus obtain fixed point iterations with adaptive guarantees of a new kind. Numerical experiments on various problems demonstrate faster convergence of AdaGrad-based fixed point iterations over Krasnoselskii--Mann iterations.
papers.summary: 该文利用非扩张映射固定点与余 cocoercive 算子零点之间的对应，把在线遗憾最小化算法系统地转换为固定点迭代，并直接由遗憾界导出残差收敛保证。在线梯度下降经转换后恢复经典 Krasnosel'skii–Mann 迭代，而 AdaGrad-Norm、对角及全矩阵版本分别产生对最佳事后标量缩放、对角预条件和正定预条件自适应的新迭代；框架还给出处理非自映射的简单方案。理论针对有限维欧氏空间中的非扩张映射，数值实验显示 AdaGrad 型迭代在多个固定点与变分不等式问题上比基线更快、更稳健。
papers.reason: 最有价值之处是把“历史信息如何进入固定点算法”从经验设计提升为一个可复用的转换原则：任何有合适遗憾界的在线算法都可能对应新的迭代及自适应残差界。AdaGrad 版本对未知尺度或预条件结构的事后适配尤其契合基于历史信息的优化研究，也为从在线学习系统地产生分裂和固定点算法提供了清晰入口。

papers.title: Incentive Design without Hypergradients: A Social-Gradient Method
papers.abstract: In incentive design problems, a system planner seeks to steer self-interested agents toward a socially optimal Nash equilibrium by issuing incentives in the presence of information asymmetry, that is, uncertainty about the agents' cost functions. A common approach formulates the problem as a Mathematical Program with Equilibrium Constraints and optimizes incentives using hypergradients-the total derivatives of the planner's objective with respect to incentives. However, computing the hypergradient typically requires full or partial knowledge of equilibrium sensitivities to incentives, which is generally unavailable under information asymmetry. In this paper, we propose a hypergradient-free incentive law, called the social-gradient flow, for incentive design when the social cost depends on the agents' joint action. We prove that the social cost gradient is a descent direction for the planner's objective, irrespective of the agent cost landscape. In the idealized setting where equilibrium responses are observable, the social-gradient flow converges to the unique socially optimal incentive. When equilibria are not directly observable, the social-gradient flow emerges as the slow-timescale limit of a two-timescale interaction, in which agents' strategies evolve on a faster timescale. We establish that the joint strategy-incentive dynamics converge to the social optimum for any agent learning rule that asymptotically tracks the equilibrium. Finally, we validate theoretical results via numerical experiments.
papers.summary: 信息不对称的激励设计通常需要通过均衡敏感度计算超梯度，但规划者往往不知道代理人的私有成本。该文针对社会成本依赖联合行动、代理博弈伪梯度强单调等条件，提出只使用社会成本梯度的 social-gradient flow，并证明该方向不依赖未知代理成本景观却仍是规划者目标的下降方向；在可观测均衡响应时，它从任意初值收敛到唯一社会最优激励。均衡不可直接观测时，作者把该流实现为代理快速学习、规划者慢速更新的双时间尺度系统，只要代理学习规则一致地渐近跟踪均衡，联合策略—激励动态仍收敛到社会最优。
papers.reason: 这项工作移除了双层优化中最昂贵、也最依赖私有信息的均衡敏感度计算，同时把结论做到对具体代理学习规则相对模块化。其证明揭示了社会成本梯度为何能穿过未知均衡映射保持下降性，对研究信息受限的博弈优化、双时间尺度算法和超梯度替代机制都很有参考价值；现有结果仍依赖强单调性及已知可行激励域。

papers.title: A Tight Surrogate-Based Adaptive Step Size for the Multiobjective Conditional Gradient Method
papers.abstract: The multiobjective conditional gradient (MCondG) method is an effective descent-type algorithm for solving constrained multiobjective optimization problems. In this algorithm, the adaptive step size is derived by minimizing a one-dimensional convex quadratic surrogate function, which guarantees a sufficient decrease in all objective functions at each iteration. However, we observe that this surrogate function is relatively conservative, producing overly small step sizes and consequently slowing the convergence of the algorithm. This conservativeness stems from the fact that the surrogate function is dominated by the largest Lipschitz constant among the gradients of all objective functions. Motivated by this observation, we develop a tighter quadratic surrogate function that exploits the individual gradient Lipschitz constants. Based on this surrogate, we propose a new adaptive step size strategy obtained by evaluating this surrogate over a finite candidate set. We prove that the proposed step size preserves the descent property of the MCondG method, and has an improved worst-case complexity bound compared with the original adaptive step size strategy. Numerical experiments on benchmark and real-world problems demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy in terms of computational efficiency and solution quality.
papers.summary: 多目标条件梯度法的经典自适应步长用所有目标梯度 Lipschitz 常数的最大值构造统一二次上界，因而可能被最坏曲率主导并产生过小步长。该文保留各目标自己的 Lipschitz 常数，构造分段二次的更紧代理，并证明只需在有限候选点上求值即可精确得到步长，无需额外线搜索。在紧致凸约束集、各目标光滑且梯度 Lipschitz 的条件下，新步长保持所有目标分量下降，迭代收敛到 Pareto 平稳点，并给出比原自适应规则更紧的最坏情形次线性界。实验中步长通常显著增大，迭代数和计算时间下降而解集质量保持相当。
papers.reason: 推荐关注它对保守代理的定位十分具体：不是再引入复杂子问题，而是利用原先被最大 Lipschitz 常数抹去的逐目标曲率信息，得到可有限枚举、仍保持可行与下降的步长。这个思路适合迁移到其他由多个上界共同控制的自适应算法；实际使用时需注意论文当前假设各个 Lipschitz 常数已知。

papers.title: Variational Analysis in Spectral Decomposition Systems
papers.abstract: This work is concerned with the variational analysis of functions defined on Euclidean spaces whose values depend solely on certain invariants (``spectrum'') of their arguments, a class we term ``spectral functions.'' Building on our previous work on the convex analysis of such functions, we work in the abstract framework of spectral decomposition systems, which covers a wide range of previously studied settings, including eigenvalue decomposition of Hermitian matrices and singular value decomposition of rectangular matrices, and allows the derivation of new results in more general settings such as normal decomposition systems. The main results of this work provide constructive formulae for computing the regular, limiting, and Clarke subdifferentials of a spectral function in terms of the corresponding objects of the associated invariant function. Finally, we obtain a generalization of Lidskiĭ's theorem on the spectrum of additive perturbations of Hermitian matrices to arbitrary spectral decomposition systems.
papers.summary: 矩阵与算子优化中的谱函数只依赖特征值、奇异值等不变量，但既有广义次微分公式往往需要针对不同分解结构分别证明。该文在抽象谱分解系统中建立统一的“先在不变量空间求对象、再提升回原空间”几何框架，覆盖 Hermitian 特征值、矩形矩阵奇异值、Euclidean Jordan 代数及更一般的正规分解系统。作者先给出谱集合的正则与极限法锥公式，再导出谱函数的正则、极限和 Clarke 次微分、Fréchet 可微性的完整刻画，并把 Lidskiĭ 加法扰动定理推广到任意谱分解系统。
papers.reason: 这是一篇偏工具型但覆盖面很广的理论工作：它把非凸谱优化所需的多种一阶变分对象压缩为同一套可构造公式，同时解决了正规分解系统中缺少广义次微分公式的问题。对低秩、矩阵恢复和非凸 Schatten 惩罚等算法分析而言，这些公式可直接用于写出必要最优性条件，并为进一步研究解映射的度量正则性提供统一底座。

papers.title: Genericity of Polyak-Lojasiewicz Inequalities for Entropic Mean-Field Neural ODEs
papers.abstract: We address the behavior of idealized deep residual neural networks (ResNets), modeled via an optimal control problem set over continuity (or adjoint transport) equations. The continuity equations describe the statistical evolution of the features in the asymptotic regime where the layers of the network form a continuum. The velocity field is expressed through the network activation function, which is itself viewed as a function of the statistical distribution of the network parameters (weights and biases). From a mathematical standpoint, the control is interpreted in a relaxed sense, taking values in the space of probability measures over the set of parameters. We investigate the optimal behavior of the network when the cost functional arises from a regression problem and includes an additional entropic regularization term on the distribution of the parameters. In this framework, we focus in particular on the existence of stable optimizers --that is, optimizers at which the Hessian of the cost is non-degenerate. We show that, for an open and dense set of initial data, understood here as probability distributions over features and associated labels, there exists a unique stable global minimizer of the control problem. Moreover, we show that such minimizers satisfy a local Polyak--Lojasiewicz inequality, which can lead to exponential convergence of the corresponding gradient descent when the initialization lies sufficiently close to the optimal parameters. This result thus demonstrates the genericity (with respect to the distribution of features and labels) of the Polyak--Lojasiewicz condition in ResNets with a continuum of layers and under entropic penalization.
papers.summary: 论文把无限深、无限宽 ResNet 理想化为由连续性方程驱动的均值场最优控制，控制变量是参数空间上的概率测度，并在回归损失中加入相对熵正则。借助激活族的判别/通用逼近性质与二阶扰动分析，作者证明在带有限三阶矩的特征—标签初始分布空间中，存在一个开且稠密的集合，使每个初值对应的控制问题都有唯一、Hessian 非退化的稳定全局极小点。对这些极小点附近，论文进一步建立局部 Polyak–Lojasiewicz 不等式；若梯度流从足够近处初始化，代价可据此指数收敛。
papers.reason: 它把 PL 条件从方便的分析假设推进为在一类均值场神经 ODE 中的泛性结论，并解释了通用逼近性质如何转化为最优解的稳定性。值得注意的是结论是对初始数据的开稠密集合成立、且 PL 性质局部有效，因此它提供的是非凸景观机理而非任意初始化的全局训练保证；这一边界也使结果更适合作为后续算法局部加速分析的基础。

papers.title: Continuous-time multi-armed bandits under random intervention times
papers.abstract: This paper examines multi-armed bandits with $J$ independent arms in which actions are taken at random discrete times. When an arm is operated, it must remain active for a renewal inter-arrival time. For arms evolving as a Lévy process, we provide an explicit characterization of the Gittins index, known to yield an optimal strategy. Furthermore, when the inter-arrival times are exponential and the arms evolve as a spectrally negative Lévy process, a reflected spectrally negative Lévy process, or a diffusion process, the Gittins index is explicitly characterized in terms of the scale function or diffusion characteristics, respectively. Convergence analysis and numerical experiments are performed to support the theoretical results.
papers.summary: 该文研究只能在随机离散时刻切换的连续时间多臂老虎机：一旦选择某臂，就必须运行到下一次更新间隔结束，间隔服从可依赖于臂的更新分布。作者对一般 Lévy 臂把 Gittins 指数表示为奖励函数对一个概率测度的变换，并证明相应指数策略最优；当更新间隔为指数分布时，又分别用尺度函数或扩散特征显式刻画谱负 Lévy、反射谱负 Lévy和扩散臂。论文还证明当干预越来越频繁时，随机干预指数单调收敛到连续干预指数并给出收敛速度。主要结论假设奖励函数单调，以把最优停止区域化为下穿越结构。
papers.reason: 随机决策时钟介于离散与连续控制之间，论文不仅证明指数策略仍最优，还把原本高维的资源分配问题降为可计算的一维最优停止对象，并量化其向连续干预极限的过渡。这个“随机可更新性如何改变最优指数”的结果对在线决策和事件触发控制都有明确理论价值；非单调奖励下停止区域的几何仍是开放问题。

papers.title: Moving-Average Iteration of Linear Maps
papers.abstract: We consider moving-average iteration for fixed complex matrices and place the theory in the general context of Krasnoselskii and Mann iteration. Necessary and sufficient spectral conditions for the asymptotic stability of moving-average iteration are presented in dependence on the fixed window width. For the corresponding region of stability in the complex plane explicit formulas are derived and it is shown that the region is open, convex and semi-algebraic. The regions are shown to be strictly increasing in the window length and the limiting stability region is determined as the window size tends to infinity.
papers.summary: 论文考虑线性映射的固定窗口移动平均迭代，把最近 $m$ 个历史状态先平均再应用映射，并置于 Krasnoselskii–Mann 迭代框架中分析。作者证明矩阵迭代渐近稳定当且仅当其谱落在与窗口宽度对应的复平面区域内，给出这些区域的显式公式，并证明它们是开、凸、半代数集合。稳定区域随窗口长度严格扩大；当 $m\to\infty$ 时，其并集并不是连续时间稳定半平面的全部，而是由 $ξ<η\cot η$（$η\in(-π,0)\cup(0,π)$）与实轴区间共同描述的真子集。
papers.reason: 这项工作精确回答了“使用多少历史平均能稳定哪些线性模式”，并揭示窗口变长虽严格扩张稳定域，却不能无限逼近所有连续时间稳定系统。对历史信息优化而言，这提供了少见的必要充分谱条件，可用来区分历史平均带来的真实稳定增益与无法跨越的离散迭代边界；现有结论聚焦固定线性映射，噪声和非线性推广仍待研究。

papers.title: Distributed Intraday Energy Management for 16.7-Hz Railway Power Systems---Part I: Theoretical Foundations
papers.abstract: In a series of three papers, we propose a distributed intraday scenario planner for energy management in 16.7-Hz single-phase railway power systems, which is realized and tested as open-source Python package bahnstrom_ems v0.9.1. The first part of our work develops the mathematical foundation of a two-layer energy management system for a 16.7-Hz single-phase railway power network, where the network is an interconnection of several control areas. Given a day-ahead plan, last measurement of stored energy in wayside batteries, and forecasts of the tractive, available regenerative and renewable energy, we provide a mathematical modeling of the 16.7-Hz single-phase railway power network in intraday time-scale. Then the intraday energy planning is formulated as a risk-neutral convex stochastic optimization problem. The overall intraday planning is shown to be a sparse convex quadratic program. Hence, this problem is solved recursively by adopting a distributed scenario model predictive control (MPC) setting. The corresponding area problems, coordination updates, convergence conditions, and closed-loop key-performance-index accumulation are derived. In practice, detailed train-motion and microscopic motoring and regenerative-power profiles are usually needed for accurate simulations and numerical validation purposes. Due to data privacy and security concerns, detailed train-motion and microscopic motoring and regenerative-power profiles in a real power network may not be publicly available. Therefore, we also propose a mathematically-solid approach to estimate such microscopic information by converting causally timetable and train-motion information into quarter-hour motoring and regenerative-power profiles while exactly preserving each hourly energy target.
papers.summary: 该文为多控制区 16.7 Hz 铁路电网建立日前—日内两层能源管理模型，把牵引、再生制动、可再生能源与路侧电池不确定性组织成风险中性的情景 MPC。作者证明日内规划等价于稀疏凸二次规划，耦合只需通过边界相角副本表达；由此分解为各区域局部 QP 和共识 ADMM 协调，并给出残差停止量、收敛到集中式最优解的条件及闭环 KPI 累积规则。针对真实微观列车功率数据难以公开的问题，论文还给出因果的时刻表驱动合成方法，把小时目标转换为 15 分钟牵引与再生功率轨迹，同时精确保留每小时能量。
papers.reason: 推荐价值在于它把一个细节繁多的随机网络调度问题整理成可证明等价、可分解且可递归执行的凸结构，而不是只给出一个应用仿真。相角共识、局部稀疏 QP、情景非预见性与能量守恒数据合成之间的接口，对分布式 MPC 和隐私受限能源优化具有直接借鉴意义；算法核心采用共识 ADMM，创新主要体现在完整建模与可验证分解。

papers.title: Iterative Single-Loop Coordination of Transmission and Distribution Systems and DER Aggregators with Limited Information Sharing
papers.abstract: The growing integration of DERs underscores the importance of unified coordination across TSO, DSO, and aggregator levels. This paper proposes a coordination method between TSO, DSOs and DER aggregators, based on a transparent, well-scalable, and decentralized single-loop iterative mechanism with limited information sharing. The approach enables iterative price-based coordination between adjacent levels, where the higher-level entities provide price signals and the lower-level ones respond with desired power schedules. The proposed method uses the proximal-gradient-based iterative co-optimization algorithm extended to a three-level case, which enjoys convergence characteristic of proximal algorithms. The performance of the proposed approach is compared with both a centralized formulation and a sequential reference formulation based on fixed transmission-level energy prices. The results demonstrate that the proposed coordination achieves outcomes very close to those obtained with the centralized formulation, while significantly improving performance relative to the sequential reference, particularly at higher levels of DER flexibility.
papers.summary: 论文把输电运营商、多个配电运营商与分布式能源聚合商的协调扩展为三层单循环机制：相邻层之间由上层发送边际价格，下层只返回期望有功/无功计划，各实体保留自己的优化模型。该方法以近端梯度型迭代共优化为基础，在有限信息交换下继承收敛性质，并可结合机会约束潮流表示不确定性。数值结果显示其解接近集中式基准，且明显优于固定输电边际价格的顺序协调；在示例的高灵活性配置下，总发电成本约下降 2.8%，峰值发电下降 13.7%。分析采用完美预测的多时段规划，尚未展开不确定性影响的专门比较。
papers.reason: 它解决的是分布式优化中很实际的接口问题：如何在不交换 ADMM 式内部辅助变量的情况下，用经济可解释的价格—功率消息把两层协调扩展到三层。单循环结构与局部模型自治使方案更接近市场落地，也为研究层级网络中的有限信息协调提供了清晰基线；推荐时应同时注意其主要证据来自仿真，且当前多时段实验依赖完美预测。

papers.title: Viscosity-Informed Generative Actor-Critic for High-Dimensional Stochastic Optimal Control
papers.abstract: We introduce a method for approximating viscosity solutions of stationary degenerate elliptic Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equations on bounded domains arising in stochastic exit-time control. Viscosity enforcement is formulated as a min--max problem over an envelope-generated test family parameterized by symmetric positive definite matrices. Under structural and asymptotic assumptions, any uniform limit point of the value function approximations satisfies the viscosity inequalities on the sampled test family. Numerical experiments show that the proposed method reduces empirical viscosity violations and improves robustness under perturbed dynamics.
papers.summary: 高维随机退出时间控制对应的退化椭圆 HJB 方程未必有 $C^2$ 值函数，直接最小化强形式残差可能选不到正确的黏性解。该文用 Moreau 包络生成测试函数族，把黏性次解与上解不等式写成关于正定矩阵参数的极小极大惩罚，并用生成式近端网络摊销原本需要反复求解的 argmin；该惩罚与时序差分和策略梯度组成三网络 V-GAC。在线性增长、比较原理、边界正则以及采样/逼近渐近条件下，任意一致收敛子列在所采样测试族上满足黏性不等式。多类控制实验报告更少的经验黏性违例，并在动力学扰动下表现更稳健。
papers.reason: 推荐关注它把黏性解的测试函数定义真正变成可训练目标，避免把值函数不具经典二阶光滑性的问题简单交给强残差网络。生成式近端映射使内层包络计算可摊销，也展示了“数学解概念—极小极大损失—actor-critic”之间的完整转换；理论保证目前只覆盖采样测试族及一致极限点，尚不是对完整测试函数类的全局收敛证明。
